attempts.summary: Configured node1 as an internal DNS resolver (dnsmasq) resolving inventory-api.internal to node2's IP (10.100.121.11), forwarding all other queries upstream to 10.100.121.1. Configured node2 (via NetworkManager) to use node1 (10.100.121.10) as its DNS resolver. Verified both internal and external resolution work from node2 through node1. Completed the mandatory restart evidence protocol on both nodes: node1 was rebooted twice (first reboot exposed a dnsmasq boot-race against DHCP where the service failed to bind to the not-yet-assigned IP; fixed with a systemd drop-in adding After/Wants=network-online.target and Restart=on-failure; second reboot confirmed the fix holds, with dnsmasq starting cleanly and DNS resolution working immediately). node2 was rebooted once, with DNS resolver config and resolution confirmed intact afterward.
